answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit that only unlocks gradually as unrelated, established peers attest its real work over many epochs — a trust terrace built one verified step at a time, never bought in bulk. A newcomer starts at the bottom of the canyon with zero influence and must earn each attestation by doing checkable work. A sybil farmer who splits one deposit across a hundred fake identities gets a hundred lotus buds instead of one strong voice: each fake must do the work, pay the lock-up, and risk slashing if caught, so faking a crowd costs as much as joining it honestly.
